result.markdown:
# Grand Tunis Sites Outage and Transport Link Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarms and topology link LNK-TUN-01-B to the site outages without a covering maintenance window, unlike LNK-TUN-01-C.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-24 11:15 to 2026-09-24 15:37
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-24 11:48
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-008, S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, S-TUN-017

## Summary

Fiber link LNK-TUN-01-B suffered an unplanned link loss causing outages on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-008, while LNK-TUN-01-C underwent planned maintenance.

Six sites in Grand Tunis experienced outages due to a combination of planned maintenance on one fiber link and an unplanned transport failure on another.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-24 11:15: Region-level traffic alert ALR-0030 started affecting six sites. [ALR-0030]
- 2026-09-24 11:18: Maintenance window MW-0010 started on LNK-TUN-01-C. [MW-0010]
- 2026-09-24 11:23: Critical link loss alarm raised on LNK-TUN-01-C. [ALM-000412]
- 2026-09-24 11:48: Critical link loss alarm raised on LNK-TUN-01-B. [ALM-000416]
- 2026-09-24 11:49: Critical site down alarms raised on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-008. [ALM-000417, ALM-000418, ALM-000419]
- 2026-09-24 15:37: Last site down alarm cleared on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000417]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-008 are located under fiber link LNK-TUN-01-B. [T7]
- No maintenance window covered LNK-TUN-01-B during the incident. [T5]
- Critical link loss occurred on LNK-TUN-01-B at 11:48 without an associated maintenance plan. [ALM-000416]
- Maintenance window MW-0010 only covers LNK-TUN-01-C and its downstream sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, and S-TUN-017. [MW-0010, T6]
- No changes were found on the affected sites or their parents during the window. [T3]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-B: confirmed. LNK-TUN-01-B suffered an unplanned link loss raising alarms on its dependent sites without any covering maintenance window. [ALM-000416, T5, T7]
2. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-TUN-01-C: confirmed. MW-0010 explicitly covered LNK-TUN-01-C and explained the outage for sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, and S-TUN-017. [MW-0010, T6]
3. **bad_change**: rejected. Tool checks confirmed that no configuration changes occurred on the affected nodes during the window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0031: This alert occurred later in the evening on 2026-09-24 and is unrelated to the morning outages.

## Recommended actions

- Investigate the root cause of the unplanned link loss on LNK-TUN-01-B.
- Verify that all transport links return to normal operational states following maintenance and incidents.
